$comment: TypeMon romanization rules. Shared by every implementation (TS today, Kotlin/Swift later). Lowercase only; casing is applied by the engine. `multi` is ordered: the first match wins, so longer and more specific entries come first. An i right after a single vowel is й, never и (oi → ой, qi → өй, yai → яй); ii is ий, and after a long vowel it stays и (aai → ааи). `afterConsonant` applies to a single letter that follows one of `consonants` in the same word, before `single` (ulsyn → улсын, but y → й elsewhere).
